title: Ally
wikitext:
'''Ally''' refers to any creature on the player's side. They are subject to effects granted by equipment and skills, which have in their description "grants (effect) to nearby allies". Allies include:
* Players in your party
* [[Minion]]s
* [[Totem]]s
* [[Mirage Archer Support|Mirage Archers]], [[Mirage Warriors]], [[Mirage Saviours]] and [[Mirage Chieftains]]

The player is '''not''' their own ally; if an effect states simply "allies" (for example {{il|Kingmaker}}), it will not affect the source the effect originates from. Effects that affect both the source and their allies specify "you and allies" (for example {{il|Vitality}}).

The term '''party members''' refers only to players in a team, which affect the properties of [[unique]] [[equipment]]s and [[passive skill]]s. Minions and other creatures are not party members.

==Auras==
{{main|Aura}}
All auras affect both the player and their allies in a certain radius. This radius can be increased by passive skills.

==Gems==
===Skill gems===
There are {{Drop enabled gem count|where=items.class_id="Active Skill Gem" AND (skill.description LIKE "%allies%" OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%allies%")}} [[skill gem]]s that directly mention allies. Additionally, {{il|Conversion Trap}} temporarily converts an enemy to an ally.

{{Drop enabled gem table
|where=items.class_id="Active Skill Gem"
  AND (skill.description LIKE "%allies%" OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%allies%")
}}

===Support gems===
{{Drop enabled gem table
|where=items.class_id="Support Skill Gem"
  AND (skill.description LIKE "%allies%" OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%allies%")
}}

==Unique items==
Items that affect allies, excluding [[Aura]] items:
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=item_stats._pageID=items._pageID
|where=
     items.stat_text LIKE "%ally%"
  OR items.stat_text LIKE "%allies%"
|large=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

Items that affect only party members:
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=item_stats._pageID=items._pageID
|where=
     items.stat_text LIKE "%party member%"
|large=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

==Passive skills==
These passive skills that interact with Allies:
{{Query passive skills
|where=
     passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%ally%"
  OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%allies%"
  OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%party_member%"
}}
